topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I just found out the last tenants left a bunch of junk up in the attic. How could they just dump all this stuff and walk away? It's not like they couldn't take it with them or get rid of it properly. Now I’m the one who has to sort through this mess. Why would anyone leave behind a pile of old clothes, broken toys, and who knows what else? This attic is a disaster area, and I’m the one who’s going to have to clean it up. Great. Just great.
